## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

## 💡 Motivation & Use Case
Explain why this capability is valuable (e.g., ROS 2 topic publisher, ByteTrack multi-object tracking, TensorRT export, 3D LiDAR fusion).

## 📐 Proposed Architectural / Implementation Outline
- **Component**: [e.g. `src/detector.py`, ROS 2 Node, ONNX export, ByteTrack tracker]
- **Target Hardware / Runtime**: [e.g. Jetson Orin Nano, Raspberry Pi 5, CUDA Server]
- **Expected Inputs & Outputs**: [e.g. Sensor RGB stream -> 3D Cone coordinates (X, Y, Z)]

## 🛠️ Proposed Implementation Approach
Outline the planned changes and API signatures.

## ➕ Additional Context
Add any other context, benchmarks, or reference papers here.
